B. Release / market classification

QUALITY PRIORITY Premium process-improvement goal: TAN ≤0.03 mg KOH/g and lighter colour where commercially achievable. Existing grade specifications above retain the earlier ≤0.05 TAN acceptance level until validation.

BASE-OIL GROUP Do not label Group II solely on colour, viscosity or VI. Group II additionally requires saturates ≥90%, sulphur ≤0.03% and VI 80 to <120 under API base-stock definitions; test the relevant parameters before claiming any Group classification.

CUSTOMER RELEASE Confirm grade using a representative batch COA. Add buyer-specific metals, oxidation stability and odour testing where the application requires it.

REFERENCE BASIS Existing Rerol RRBO Product Specification (July 2026); ASTM base-oil tests; API base-stock classification guidance.
